description: This Java class configures OpenAPI documentation metadata and global CORS settings for the notes backend application.

classes.name: OpenApiAndCorsConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class setting up OpenAPI documentation and CORS policies.

methods.name: notesOpenAPI
methods.description: Creates and returns an OpenAPI object with API metadata and external documentation link.

methods.name: corsConfigurer
methods.description: Creates and returns a WebMvcConfigurer bean that configures CORS mappings to allow all origins and standard HTTP methods for /api/** endpoints.
